reader.requirement: Every WRITE, successful or not, must update the I-O status of its file (and so the FILE STATUS item) to the value VII-2 assigns: '00' on success, '48' when not open in output or extend mode, '44' on a RECORD VARYING size violation, and the module's own values for relative and indexed files.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError: random/dynamic key below 1 answers invalid key '24' below 2014 (§1985:VIII.1.3.4 c) and permanent error '34' from 2014

reader.edition-search: Grep 'IsActive|Edition' over SequentialConnector.cs and IndexedConnector.cs: none on WRITE; the FILE STATUS store after WRITE (EmitStoreFileStatus) has no edition test.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: a relative random WRITE with key 0 answers '24' at 1985 (the 1985 arm) where 2014 and later answer '34'; the sequential values are the same
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness checks WRITE statuses on an unopened file; output/extend success, '48' in input mode, '44' RECORD VARYING violations and relative/indexed values are not exercised

probes.printed: W1 not open 48 (preset 99); W2 output 00; W3 input mode 48; W4 extend 00 (preset 99); W5 VL=2 below min 44, record area ABCDEFGH unchanged; W6 00; W7 VL=9 above max 44 unchanged; W8 relative 00; W9 duplicate 22; W10 key 0 24; W11 indexed 00; W12 out of sequence 21; W13 equal key 21
probes.expected: §1985:VII.1.3.5: '00', '48' not open in output or extend, '44' boundary violation of the RECORD VARYING sizes (GR8 also: record area unaffected); relative '22' and '24' (§1985:VIII.1.3.4 c); indexed '21' sequence error

probes.printed: RECORD VARYING FROM 4 TO 8 DEPENDING ON VL: 2 -> 44, 6 -> 00, 9 -> 44
probes.expected: GR8: 44 below the smallest or above the largest size

reader.notes: Every WRITE shape sets the connector status and the emitter stores it into the FILE STATUS item after the statement, overwriting a stale value. The one edition branch on this path (relative key out of range) takes the 1985 arm, which matches the 1985 Relative I-O status text.

refuter.evidence: rst1-001 (--std 85), status preset 99 before each relative WRITE: relative SEQUENTIAL access, RELATIVE KEY PIC 9, ten WRITEs -> 00 x9 (KR 1..9), tenth 24 (the sequential-WRITE key-overflow arm of §1985:VIII.1.3.4 c, not probed by the reader); indexed with ALTERNATE KEY WITH DUPLICATES -> 02, unique alternate duplicate -> 22, prime duplicate -> 22; relative random RECORD VARYING 2..5 DEPENDING: 1 -> 44, 6 -> 44, 5 -> 00; indexed sequential RECORD VARYING 3..6: 2 -> 44, 7 -> 44, 6 -> 00. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR6; OK §1985:VIII.1.3.4 (key digits larger than relative key, GRL2.2b/2.3c); OK §1985:IX.1.3.4 '02 ... duplicate key is detected'.
